ctaHeading: Diamond Creek's painters are ready — let's refresh your property.
aboutText: With 30 years of dedicated painting and repair experience, Complete Painting and Repair is Diamond Creek's trusted choice. Todd and his skilled crew specialise in challenging projects, from achieving the perfect colour match on tricky exteriors to delivering seamless interior finishes. We take pride in work so meticulous, you'd never know we were there. For professional results you can see and feel, choose the local experts.
servicesText: From single rooms to entire properties, we handle all painting and repair needs. Our team delivers impeccable interior and exterior results, ensuring every surface looks its best with lasting colour and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: We transform Diamond Creek homes with precise colour matching and expert wall, ceiling, and trim painting for a flawless finish.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Our crew tackles challenging facades and weatherboards, using quality paints to boost your property's curb appeal and protection.

services.title: Colour Consultation
services.desc: Get expert advice on perfect colour palettes that complement your home and style, with samples applied before we start.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repair
services.desc: We fill cracks, repair damaged surfaces, and sand thoroughly to ensure a smooth, long-lasting paint application every time.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: We provide professional painting services for Diamond Creek businesses, offices, and retail spaces to enhance your brand's image.

services.title: Strata & Body Corporate
services.desc: Trustworthy, coordinated painting for multi-unit properties and common areas, managed with clear communication.
